quantize_with_higgs: quantize a 2D weight tensor using HIGGS LUT quantization with configurable bits, group size, and hadamard size
create_HiggsLinear: create a HiggsLinear module for inference with pre-quantized weights, scales, and lookup tables
replace_with_higgs_linear: replace Linear layers in a PyTorch model with HIGGS quantized HiggsLinear layers
run_qgemm_inference: run quantized matrix multiplication inference using qgemm_v2 with HiggsLinear forward pass
dequantize_higgs: dequantize HiggsLinear layers in a model by replacing them with standard torch.nn.Linear layers
